name: Ingot
author: E. T. Carter
description: A sheet of brushed metal catching the light — fine horizontal grooves scatter a broad anisotropic highlight that sweeps slowly across the surface, glinting along the brush lines. A close-up metal material rather than an object, filling the frame.

params.label: Sweep speed
params.effect: How fast the bright highlight sweeps across the sheet; 0 holds it still.

params.label: Brush
params.effect: Coarseness of the brushed grooves; low is a wide satin grain, high is fine tight brushing.

params.label: Sheen
params.effect: Brightness of the swept highlight and the glints riding it.

params.label: Anisotropy
params.effect: How stretched the highlight is along the brush direction; low is a tight line, high a broad sheet of light.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer tilts the sheet into the light; 0 ignores the mouse.
